tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam rab klong rtsa lho pas zhus pa'i spring yig bzhugs so// shrī sa skya pa 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong gi sku gsung thugs kyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge 'dam thob khul na 'khod pa'i gzugs can gzugs med spyi dang / khyad par seb rong rgyal po zhes bla dwags su 'bod pa na 'khod pa rnams la springs pa/ 'dam thob 'di'i snod bcud rnams skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud bla brang go bzhi bzhugs pa'i nang tshan lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud kha shas dang / yang dgos bdag chen kun dga' legs pa/ zhes mkhas grub kyi skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyis bstan 'gro yongs la dge ba'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad myong nas sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por 'dam thob kyi 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad por gdung brgyud gcig phebs dgos nan gsol mdzad pa bzhin sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma de nyid kyi dus gsum blang dor gsal ston bka' shog zab brling phebs nas/ 'gyangs min sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug gis 'dzin skyong zhal bdag mdzad pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du dpal sa skya nas bla ma dang dpon ngo g.yog zla bo zhon khal nyer spyad bcas de phyogs kyi lugs gnyis la rgya'i do dam par mngags bzhin pa 'di yin pas/ des na spyir gu ru pad+ma sogs rgya bod mkhas grub du mas lha srin sde brgyad kyi srog snying bzhes pa'am/ mdongs gsol du phul ba sogs kyi sgo nas bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad pa'i gras su 'gro ba'ang yod srid cing khyad par 'dam thob bdag chen sa skya pa'i gdung dngos dang / sku tshab dge bshes rdo rje 'dzin pa du mas bsangs sogs kyis mgron du bos nas gnas mgron dam tshig bsrung bar bsgos pa dang gnod pa mi byed par gdams pa sogs tha tshig rim chen yod 'gro yang /

'ga' zhig nas mi rnams kyi bya spyod phran bu 'gal bar 'khu ldog 'dra mo byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig nas ko long phrag dog rgyu 'bras la mi brtsi ba lta bus mi la na tsha zhon khal phyugs sogs la god kha/ ri klung la gnod pa bya nyes jus nyes gtong ba sogs mi 'tshams pa du ma zhig yong 'dra bas/ deng phyin chad rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang / las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden tshig la nges shes yang dag bskyed de 'di par 'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'dod pa'i rigs su 'gro ba spu tsam yang ma byed par mthun rkyen tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel ba sogs legs tshogs thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i grogs dan yang dag gyis/ de ltar ma byas na/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te bsgo ba bzhin ma byas na/ 'di'i khyod kyis mgo bo 'gems par byed do lta bu'i tshig gis bka' bsgo rnams yal bar bor bar 'gyur bas/ khyod rnams ya nga ba'i gnas su ltung bar 'gyur zhing / gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud sde rnams las/ bstan la gnod par byed pa dang / /bla ma sangs rgyas 'jig pa rnams/ /bla ma thub pa la zhus nas/ /snying rjes gsad par bya ba nyid/ /ces dang / gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /zhes dang / shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi ba nye bar mi bya ste/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can gyi ni/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /gsungs pa yin pas/ snod bcud drag po'i rnam rol du bsgyur nas/ dgug 'dren 'ching sdom mnan sreg bsad pa sogs kyi sgo nas rdo rje 'dzin pa srin po khros pa'i cha byad can rnams sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul sha khrag srog dbugs skad cig la 'jigs rngams du mas gsol zhing sdug bsngal mi bzod pa skyed par mdzad pa'i bka'i chad pa drag po 'byung ta re/ de bas na kho bo'i bsgo ba las ma 'da' bar bstan 'gro yongs la dge ba'i lhag bsam myur du bskyed pa gal che/

zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang yang rtse'i gzim chung 'dzam gling phun tshogs dpal 'bar zhes rten gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ring bsrel snying po can du ma bzhugs drung nas sdom gsum ldan pa kun dga' blo gros zhes kun phan rang bzhin du 'char ba des bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rna rab klong rtsa lho pas zhus pa'i springs yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
